title: Chapter 187 The Carrot In Front Of The Donkey
content:
Chapter 187 The Carrot In Front Of The Donkey

Han Fei's running around was not always smooth sailing. On the way, he also experienced the assassination of the snares sent by Qin, and many forces who did not want the alliance to be established sent their own assassins.

On the way, it can be said that Han Fei almost died, and Han Fei almost couldn't come back, but fortunately, despite all kinds of hardships, Han Fei still completed the task.

As for Zhong Yu, when Han Fei finished his mission to Yan and Zhao, he had already bid farewell to the king of Han, returned to the royal country, and prepared to recruit a large army to join the coalition forces.

Today's Yuguo has conquered the Huns and the two losers in the north.

And by accepting the terms of the surrender of the two, Yuguo can draw warriors from the two countries to join the army of Yuguo to fight for Yuguo.

Just after returning to Yu Kingdom, before he had time to take a good rest, Zhong Yu issued an order to recruit an army.

The whole country has concentrated 100,000 troops and prepared military supplies, which will be sent to Zhao and South Korea in a few months.

And the Huns in the north will also gather 100,000 troops to go out with them. Moreover, the other two losers will each send 50,000 soldiers to the south of the Huns, which is the northern border of Qin, to harass them.

...

Inside the barracks, flags were flying at this moment, and layers of military tents stretched for more than ten miles.

"Your Majesty, the army going south has been assembled, with a total of 100,000 people, all of whom are elites who have experienced many battles!" said Cao Cao, who had just returned from the expedition, beside Zhong Yu, who was reviewing the army.

When he first came to this world, Zhong Yu's entire country had only 200,000 troops, and his strength could be said to be extremely weak.

However, after more than two years of conquests, a group of recruits have been recruited from within the Imperial Kingdom, and some brave men from the conquered tribes have been recruited to join the army.

Now there are 100,000 more troops, and they are extremely brave and good at fighting. The equipment has the accumulation of the imperial kingdom, and it can be said to be extremely sophisticated. Among all the countries in the world, they are all first-class.

But these are not the most important. The important thing is that although Zhong Yu's 50,000 direct relatives lost some in the previous battles, they quickly selected some more talented people to make up for it. .

Now the establishment of 50,000 people has been completed, and most of them have broken through to the second level, which is the third-rate state in the Qin Shimingyue world.

In these armies, everyone has the true energy of Zhong Yu in their bodies, firmly controlling the core of their power, and constantly bewitching these soldiers, instilling the idea of loyalty to Zhong Yu in their subconscious minds .

After more than two years of bewitching, it can be said that he has completely become Zhong Yu's puppet. If he doesn't encounter Zhong Yu's orders, it will be fine, and he will still maintain the state of a normal person with normal thinking.

But once they encounter something about Zhong Yu, they will be very concerned. If it is a good thing, they will smile and don't care too much.

But if someone wants to do something bad by buying them, then they will have a taste of Infernal Affairs.

"Well, very good, the 100,000 army has been assembled so quickly, it seems that the lovers are not neglecting military affairs and political affairs when they are leaving Yuguo!" Zhong Yu nodded in satisfaction.

"It's all thanks to Your Majesty's blessings. Our country is under His Majesty's might, so we dare not work together and work hard to serve His Majesty!" Several officials around me looked at each other and complimented each other.

Smiling, Zhong Yu didn't really take these tired compliments to heart, but continued to look at the army under his command.

"The purpose of our sending troops to the south this time to compete with Qin State is not to destroy Qin State in one battle. That is unrealistic." Walking on the road, Zhong Yu turned his head and said to the officials beside him. "Our purpose is to take advantage of this opportunity to fight against Qin to severely weaken the seven countries in the south, let them consume their foundation in this confrontation, and drag them into the quagmire of war, from which they cannot extricate themselves!"

"Then, according to Your Majesty, this war should be delayed as long as possible, and the sooner it ends, the better?" Cao Cao, who returned to Beijing after reporting his duties, as the number one military officer under Zhong Yu's command, quickly understood him. the meaning of.

"That's right, the most important thing in this war is not the result of the battle, but the delay time, and in this long war, the strength of the seven southern countries will be weakened, and our Yu Kingdom can hide in the north and take this opportunity to recuperate. "Hearing Cao Cao's words, Zhong Yu nodded in satisfaction.

It is worthy of being Cao Cao who can unify the entire north in the Three Kingdoms world. As a very famous traitor in history, his strategic vision and tactical vision are extremely outstanding.

"How long will the war last? There must be a specific goal, so that a series of plans can be made around the goal!" Cao Cao continued to ask after hearing his majesty's affirmation of his words.

"How long does it take for a soldier to join the army at the age of 16 or above, and now our country has a shortage of young adults, most of whom are women, children and children. Because of this, our country, which has a population of 6 million, can only be recruited With 300,000 soldiers and horses, they still need to rely on servants like the Huns to have enough troops to attack the Qin State. It will take about ten years for these children to grow up, so let’s take ten years as the target period!” Thinking of the current situation of the Yu Kingdom, Zhong Yu was also helpless for a while.

"Ten years? Is this time long? It's not short, but for the princes of the world, it is a very difficult time to last!" Thinking about this time in his heart, Cao Cao felt embarrassed for a while.

For those greedy princes, it is because they have reached the moment of life and death that they can unite with the Yu Kingdom to fight against Qin's aggression.

But now the princes of the world have an allied army of millions, and with this amount of troops attacking Qin, the outcome should be decided within a short period of one or two years, and it is impossible to delay it for so long.

Can Cao Cao still demand these countries, but they persist in the interests of the imperial country, wasting their country's heritage and saving their own country's blood in vain?

"So, in order to make these greedy dogs obediently do things for our country, we must throw some bones to give them motivation and attract their attention?" Hearing Cao Cao's embarrassment, Zhong Yu didn't take offense, but instead Tell me your plan!

"Bone? What kind of bone is that?" Cao Cao didn't know how much profit his Emperor would be willing to give up to feed these greedy princes

"I don't want all the land laid down by the coalition forces, how about giving it to them?" As soon as Zhong Yu opened his mouth, Zhong Yu made a huge choice.
